raw.title: Crimean Bridge
raw.extract: The Crimean Bridge, also called Kerch Strait Bridge or Kerch Bridge, is a double road and rail bridge spanning the Kerch Strait between the Taman Peninsula of Krasnodar Krai in Russia and the Kerch Peninsula of Crimea. It consists of a four-lane road bridge, whose main span was destroyed in 2026 by a Ukrainian attack, and a double-track railway bridge. Built by Russia after its 2014 annexation of Crimea, the bridge cost ₽227.92 billion (€3.23 billion) and has a length of 19 km (12 mi), making it the longest bridge in Europe and the longest bridge constructed by Russia.
